title: Dedicated capacity conformance driver and customer acceptance protocol
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Build a repeatable conformance driver (load harness + measurement suite) and a customer-facing acceptance protocol for Dedicated Capacity throughput guarantees. This ticket scopes the harness design (shadow replay + synthetic probes), benchmarking methodology (arrival processes, tail-latency stitching, batching profile sweeps), and an acceptance checklist customers can run with us for SLA signoff. Deliverables: an automated runbook, a CI-driven benchmark job, and an onboarding packet for customers that includes reproducible assets and pass/fail criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable harness (containerized) that can run in-customer or in our test lab and produce a standardized throughput report (CSV + JSON + html summary).
Benchmarks include tail-latency (p95/p99/p999), token/sec sustained, and cost-per-token under representative mixes (chat, single-turn, embeddings).
Autoscaling policy probes that exercise scale-up/scale-down thresholds and measure stabilization time under defined burst profiles.
A customer acceptance checklist with pass/fail thresholds and remediation steps that customer success can use during onboarding.
At least two internal runs (one synthetic-heavy, one replay-driven from anonymized customer trace) with results posted to the benchmark dashboard and a PR with artifacts linked.
Playbook for adjudicating marginal failures and a proposed SLA language snippet for legal/product teams.
test_plan: Implement harness runner: supports synthetic generator and trace-replay. Parameters: qps, concurrency, seq_len_dist, batching_profile.
Integrate autoscaler probe module: configure target utilization, cooldowns, and a synthetic spike generator to force scale events.
Define workload templates: chat_interactive, batch_embeddings, and mixed_streaming with documented token distributions.
Run baseline in lab (3 runs per template): cold-start, warm-cache, and steady-state 1-hour run. Capture detailed metrics (latencies, GPU utilization, queue lengths, billing tokens).
Perform tail stitching: combine short high-res runs for p999 accuracy with longer steady-state runs for throughput stability.
Validate against customer replay: redact and replay two anonymized traces to verify real-world fidelity and identify batching/kv-cache effects.
Produce an acceptance packet: automated report, recommended autoscaling settings, suggested fallback model variants, and remediation checklist.
Gate review with PM/SE/Customer Success and run a dry-run with one pilot customer for operational validation.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Ava Morgan: Created ticket to centralize work on a reproducible conformance driver and customer acceptance protocol. Initial scope reviewed with PM and SE; aligned on 3 workload templates.
